SANIFOAM GROUP

Different areas of expertise, one roof.

  • PARENT GROUP

    Sanifoam

    Founded in İstanbul in 1990, Sanifoam Endüstri ve Tüketim Ürünleri Sanayi Ticaret A.Ş. produces foam, non-woven and related products for customers in the automotive, white goods, industrial insulation and cleaning sectors.

    Visit the website ↗(opens in a new tab)
  • THIS SITE

    Saniteks

    Besides its own brand, it produces dish, bath and car sponges under the STAR and Blues brands. It offers a wide range of household and industrial cleaning products, including microfibre cleaning cloths, scouring pads and steel scouring balls.

    Explore our products ↗

  • Sanifoam GmbH

    Sanifoam's gateway to Europe. It provides warehousing, logistics and after-sales services to automotive and industrial customers across Europe, particularly in Munich.

    Sanifoam group company

  • Ultech Ulaşım Araçları

    Works for the automotive sector and in fields such as welded fabrication, mould and fixture design and metalworking, offering customers solutions that combine engineering expertise with modern technology.

    Visit the website ↗(opens in a new tab)

  • Corefix

    Industrial adhesive solutions: produces professional double-sided, single-sided and transfer adhesive products.

    Visit the website ↗(opens in a new tab)
  • Sanicar

    Sanicar

    Provides services in factory construction, industrial plant installation, and commercial vehicle and forklift rental.
